name: The Lost Fragments
summary: Theldurin the Lost is in a panic over the Scroll of Myzrael. Its magic could drag Myzrael up to the surface, yet if she is already free, the scroll may be the only way to bind her again. Elementals in a rage have shredded it and fight over the scraps, and you are sent to gather them.

sections.title: A Dangerous Parchment
sections.body: Theldurin the Lost is alarmed at the mention of the Scroll of Myzrael, fearing its magic could draw Myzrael to the surface. Then comes a change of heart: if she has already slipped free, or is gathering strength to strike, the scroll is just what you will need to trap her again.

sections.title: Torn by the Elements
sections.body: The scroll is no longer whole. Furious elementals took it, ripped it to shreds and now fight over the scraps. You are after three pieces, one torn, one crumpled and one singed, and Theldurin means to try mending them. The thieves roam the hills behind Theldurin.

faq.q: Who sends you to collect the scroll fragments?
faq.answer: Theldurin the Lost asks you to bring back the pieces of the destroyed scroll.

faq.q: What is the Scroll of Myzrael supposed to do?
faq.answer: Theldurin says its magic could draw Myzrael up to the surface. Theldurin also thinks that, if she is already free, it is what you would need to trap her again.

aliases: where to find the scroll pieces
faq.answer: Elementals in a rage carried off the scroll, tore it up and fight over the pieces. They are in the hills behind Theldurin.
It follows your earlier dealings with Theldurin the Lost.
